'''Megda''' is a [[Tar Valon]]er [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]]. Her [[Warder]] is [[Maynard]].
== Appearance ==
Megda is a slender woman with fiery red hair, green eyes, and pale skin.
== History ==
She was known to be in [[Tobin's Hollow]] in [[Toman Head]] during the [[Seanchan]] attack in the region, after learning of rumors about women using the [[One Power]] to harm others. While in the region, she was able to convey messages by use of a ''[[ter'angreal]]''.

She was taken as ''[[damane]]'' by a ''[[sul'dam]]'' named [[Tumva]]. Her messages stopped, which alerted the attention of [[Nadira]] Sedai. She manages to escape and be reunited with Maynard when Falme is attacked by the [[Heroes of the Horn]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
